contract: Pure resolution of a model-proposed tool name over a caller-supplied snapshot of at most 64 untrusted descriptors from declared sources: deterministic ai-text-grammar alias per source and name, SHA-256 version of the canonical descriptor without trust, model-facing description fill and cut, one argument check through core/payload-schema; resolved, changed, removed (latest listing only), ambiguous or unknown, never the first match. Source kind comes only from the caller; finding a tool grants no permission. No listing, dispatch, process, clock or storage.
limits: No claim about the current tool set of a source: a change or removal after the last listing is not detected and the tool still resolves; removed covers the latest listing of a source only.
One refused descriptor refuses the whole call; no bound on schema complexity, validation time or snapshot bytes.
The digest is stable for the pinned Jason and OTP; it is not RFC 8785.
No content mark, tool-result handling, instruction loading, authority, approval or budget check; the caller maps callables to real Adapter bindings or nested callables.
Selected Cure laws cover the four supplied Booleans of the resolution decision only; lookup, alias, digest, description rule and map validation are finite tests.

grounding.claim: A live name with a differing held version is Changed for every removed and many operand.
A not-live removed name is Removed for every differs and many operand.
A not-live, not-removed name owned on two or more sources is Ambiguous for every differs operand.
A not-live, not-removed name owned on fewer than two sources is Unknown for every differs operand; no not-live row is Resolved.
Pinned Cure checks types and totality of the production resolution decision; the source audit finds no axioms, holes, unresolved, unaudited, opaque or unproved-total definitions.

Seven named groups: unknown_and_source_kind, same_name_two_sources, alias_grammar_and_bound, fresh_listing, one_validation_result, descriptor_rules, laws_and_example; temporary first-own-name-match and dropped-hash-suffix mutations are negative controls. Finite scenarios, not a universal proof.
Pinned Cure compilation, reduction checking and BEAM decision semantics; compiler soundness not locally proved.
Argument and schema checks reuse ready core/payload-schema with pinned JSV 0.27.0, draft 2020-12, no casting.
Scalar encoding inside the ready ai-text canonical encoding used for the version digest.
SHA-256 of OTP crypto for the version and the alias suffix.
Pinned Elixir immutable maps, lists and byte-wise binary operations.

The host supplies a truthful source set and source kinds, complete listings, approval of each listed source and its schemas, a record of each listing and outcome before use, the map from callables to real bindings, and authority, approval and budget checks for every action.

telemetry.contract: Pure functions emit no observations; the caller owns instrumentation.

config.contract: Intrinsic operands and fixed bounds only; no selectable settings.

control.contract: No process or lifecycle; the snapshot is caller-owned plain data.
